title: Locker Rental: overnight storage, valuables liability and contents insurance terms by tier
content:
## Scope
This document covers the Locker Rental product line. It states, for each of the six Locker Rental tiers, whether belongings may remain in the locker overnight, the extra fee for overnight storage where it is not included, the club's liability cap for valuables stored in the locker, whether supplemental contents insurance may be added, and the fee for that insurance add-on.

## Storage, liability and insurance table
| Tier | Overnight storage allowed | Overnight storage fee | Valuables liability cap | Insurance add-on available | Insurance add-on fee |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Small Locker | No | $5.00 | $50.00 | No | not applicable |
| Medium Locker | No | $5.00 | $75.00 | Yes | $3.00 |
| Large Locker | Yes | $0 (included) | $100.00 | Yes | $4.00 |
| Premium Climate-Controlled Locker | Yes | $0 (included) | $150.00 | Yes | $5.00 |
| Day-Use Locker | No | $0 | $25.00 | No | not applicable |
| VIP Locker Suite | Yes | $0 (included) | $250.00 | Yes | $6.00 |

## Equivalent restatement (by question)
- Which tier carries the highest valuables liability cap? The VIP Locker Suite, at two hundred fifty dollars.
- Is overnight storage included at no extra fee for the Large Locker tier? Yes; overnight storage is allowed for this tier and its overnight storage fee is fixed at zero.
- Can a member add supplemental contents insurance to a Small Locker rental? No; the insurance add-on is not available for this tier.

## Points of judgement
Where overnight storage is allowed as a fixed tier value (Large Locker, Premium Climate-Controlled Locker, VIP Locker Suite), the overnight storage fee fixed for those tiers is zero, meaning overnight storage is included at no extra charge; where overnight storage is not allowed (Small Locker, Medium Locker, Day-Use Locker), any overnight storage fee value fixed for the tier describes only the extra charge that would apply, not an entitlement to store overnight.
